profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Information Technology System Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Python, Multiple SQL/NoSQL Databases, Agile Methodologies, MacOS, Virtualization, CI/CD, gitlab, etc. Strong community and social services professional graduated from Green River Community College.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
SALESFORCE
AI-Driven SDLC Champion: Led adoption of spec-driven, AI-assisted development
practices using agent sessions, technical design documents, and architecture specs to
accelerate feature delivery; presented the framework company-wide to standardize
planning and team execution.
Core Platform Feature Development: Architected and developed frontend/backend
enhancements for Tableau, delivering extended visibility into job administration with
integrated task-to-job linking and automated API testing.
Enterprise API & Tooling Migration: Directed production migration from Sourcegraph
GraphQL to internal CodeSearch REST API; validated 99%+ data parity across files,
symbols, and packages while identifying and resolving critical latency bottlenecks with
the platform team.
Security & Vulnerability Management: Automated security scanning and CVE triage
workflows via Slack integrations; owned 3PL vulnerability remediation tracking, executed
multi-repository service account audits, and drove SMC Quality Assurance Reviews.
Compliance Automation: Automated SCM compliance services including GitHub
team/member syncs, code ownership tracking, and access auditing for SOC/SOC2
compliance.


TABLEAU
Zero-Downtime Patch Automation: Built Python, Flask, MySQL, and TeamCity tools to
automate system-level patching for MacOS, Windows, and Linux build environments,
achieving zero downtime while maintaining strict security standards.
Single Source of Truth ETL: Engineered ETL pipelines from various services into a
unified Tableau visualization dashboards and alerts.
Bare-Metal & Database Automation: Automated bare-metal server deployments;
automated refresh management 50+ virtual database environments for weekly test
environments.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: AI-Driven SDLC Champion: Led adoption of spec-driven, AI-assisted development practices using agent sessions, technical design documents, and architecture specs to accelerate feature delivery; presented the framework company-wide to standardize planning and team execution. Core Platform Feature Development: Architected and developed frontend/backend enhancements for Tableau, delivering extended visibility into job administration with integrated task-to-job linking and automated API testing. Enterprise API & Tooling Migration: Directed production migration from Sourcegraph GraphQL to internal CodeSearch REST API; validated 99%+ data parity across files, symbols, and packages while identifying and resolving critical latency bottlenecks with the platform team. Security & Vulnerability Management: Automated security scanning and CVE triage workflows via Slack integrations; owned 3PL vulnerability remediation tracking, executed multi-repository service account audits, and drove SMC Quality Assurance Reviews. Compliance Automation: Automated SCM compliance services including GitHub team/member syncs, code ownership tracking, and access auditing for SOC/SOC2 compliance.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Automated system level patching for MacOS, Windows, & Linux build infrastructure using Python, Flask, MySQL and Teamcity. This enabled a net zero downtown for the build environment while providing a stable and secure environment.
System configuration and state using Puppet for MacOS, Windows & Linux infrastructure.
Automated bare-metal deployment using PuppetLab Razor, Cobbler, Ansible, DeployStudio and MDT/WDS
Helped architect an on-prem Gitlab environment from a single VM and 35 users to multi-node HA and supporting 2000+ users.
Used Python and MySQL to ETL data from Puppet, Racktables, Teamcity, VMWare into a single source of truth for development infrastructure. Used Tableau to create visualizations and alerts
Utilized PowerShell and PowerCLI to manage a 50+ virtual machine database environment for developer testing, this enabled the environment to be reverted to a clean ‘GOLD’ environment on a weekly or as needed basis.
Configured and supported 25+ different databases and their environments. Including industry standards like Hadoop, Oracle and PostgreSQL, all the way to IBM DB2, Terradata and MarkLogic

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description: I was hired on to Tableau because of my Big Data background and my experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases and processing Terabytes of data daily while at my previous position with NavTeq (Nokia). At Tableau I was able to gain more experiences with just about every database out there, since Tableau is a Data Analytics company and connects to just about every datasource available. While here I was able to provide my programming background to help automate 100 of VMWare virtual machine instances, so that developers could have 'clean' databases and datasources on a weekly basis.

positions.title: Senior Data Analyst
positions.description:
Configuration and administration of a Hadoop Cluster, starting with 5 nodes and 15 terabytes utilization and growing to 35 nodes and ingesting 150 terabytes weekly.
Analyzing terabytes worth of spatial data in Oracle and Hadoop to develop models for NAVTEQ products such as Traffic Patterns. This helped more accurately deliver route travel time based on the analysis of historic speed data to real-time navigation. 
Developed applications that interfaced directly with various databases. This included ETL, automating the build of spatial k-means models and tools that helped to simplify basic  database functions and procedures. 
Integrated multiple data sources into spatial GeoDatabases for cartographic visualization. Created automated scripting for reporting and analysis and scoring the quality of each source. 
Quality assurance of traffic models to real-world data in the field.

positions.title: Senior Data Analyst
positions.description: Scaled Hadoop clusters from 5 nodes (15 TB) to 35 nodes ingesting 150+ TB weekly of spatial data for NAVTEQ products. Developed spatial models and automated ETL pipelines in Oracle and Hadoop to improve real-time route travel calculations. Integrated multi-source geographic data into spatial GeoDatabases for cartographic visualizations and automated data quality scoring.

positions.title: Geographic Information Systems Analyst
positions.description: Developed award-winning Wildland Urban Interface risk-assessment models using LiDAR topographic raster data and multi-spectral imagery. Created and maintained public-facing web applications with integrated ArcGIS mapping.
